criterion: Form validation: unclear what went wrong
description: `vein update` wants --revisions as a per-field object, and `vein resolve` wants an array. Passing the other shape, even with the current revision, returns REVISION_REQUIRED "Supply the observed field revisions", which says nothing about the shape.
expected: Both commands accept either shape, or the error says "update expects {\"status\":[\"op-…\"]}".
actual: An identical shape-blind error for both mistakes.
suggested_fix: Accept an array for single-field updates, or detect the wrong shape and name the expected form.

description: `activity --actor ada` and `--actor "Setup agent"` both return UNKNOWN_ACTOR. Only the 64-hex actor ID works, so an agent cannot easily list its own events, and there is no `--actor me`.
expected: `--actor` accepts a handle or display name (and `me`); otherwise the error lists the valid handles.
suggested_fix: Default --actor to the credential's own Actor when given `me`, and resolve display names.
